allowed: pull candidate Home Assistant OCI image
record immutable RepoDigest/image ID/platform/Python/Home Assistant version
materialize exact upstream Better Thermostat commit and subtree identities
compile and import exact custom component modules in candidate image
verify manifest/hacs metadata and declared Python requirements
verify T01 old proprietary service declaration/registration source surface and T01 new absence
verify T02 old/new exact blueprint bytes parse as YAML-shaped source under independent non-executing loader
verify no result-bearing automation/controller is installed or invoked

compare candidate behavior against frozen expected frontier

purpose: Select exact executable Home Assistant substrates for T01 historical/new and T02 common execution without using VE2 scientific outcomes or changing frozen state/frontier semantics.

selection.T01_new_target: first candidate in frozen T01_NEW_TARGET order that passes all probe obligations
selection.T01_old_history: first candidate in frozen T01_OLD_HISTORY order that passes all probe obligations
selection.T02_common: first candidate in frozen T02_COMMON order for which BOTH exact old and new sources pass all probe obligations in the same image
selection.failure: If no frozen candidate passes, discovery v1 FAILS. A successor must preserve this attempt and may only extend/change the candidate lattice prospectively while state/frontier semantics remain immutable.
